description: This Java class acts as a command handler within the Apache Fineract project, specifically handling the creation of credit bureau loan product mappings through the command pattern. It receives commands, delegates to the service layer, and returns the processing result.

classes.name: CreateCreditBureauLoanProductMappingCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class marked as a Spring @Service that handles commands for creating credit bureau loan product mappings.

methods.name: CreateCreditBureauLoanProductMappingCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the required write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command by delegating to the write platform service to add a new credit bureau loan product mapping and returns the result.
